title: Functional validation of miRNA-mRNA interactions in macrophages by inhibition/competition assays based in transient transfection
protocol: Collect cells for bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDM) from the femur of female BALB/c mice (6-8 weeks).
Wash the femurs with cold PBS.
Collect BMDMs by centrifuging at 500 x g for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend the cells in RPMI 1640 medium supplemented with penicillin, streptomycin, heat-inactivated fetal bovine serum, and L9-29 conditioned medium.
Transfer to 75 cm² culture flasks.
Incubate at 34°C and 5% CO₂ for 7 days.
Evaluate cell viability using Trypan blue staining 1:1 and count in Neubauer chamber.
Harvest BMDM with 1 mM EDTA in PBS after 7 days of incubation.
Incubate the cells with the EDTA-PBS solution at 34°C for 10 min.
Collect the cells by scraping followed by centrifuging at 500 x g for 5 min at 4°C.
Wash the collected cells with PBS.
Resuspend the cells in RPMI 1640 medium supplemented as previously described.
Incubate 1 x 10^6 cells with anti-mouse CD11b-PE and anti-F4/80-APC antibody diluted 1:100 in FACS-buffer at 4°C for 30 min.
Seed 2 x 10^5 cells/well into 8-well glass chamber slides or 5 x 10^5 cells/well into 24-well plates in RPMI 1640 medium supplemented as described above, overnight at 34°C in an atmosphere of 5% CO2.
Check cell confluence (80%).
Wash cells with PBS to remove non-adherent cells.
Add RPMI 1640 medium supplemented as described above.
Clone the predicted binding site sequences into pmiRGLO vector.
Design sense oligonucleotides with a Sac I restriction site for vector cloning.
Include the binding site for miR-294 in the sense oligonucleotide sequence.
Design antisense oligonucleotides with an Xba I restriction site for vector cloning.
Include the binding site for miR-294 in the antisense oligonucleotide sequence.

Prepare the PCR reaction mix total volume 50 μL with 2X Top Taq Master Mix, 5 μL of 10 X CoralLoad Concentrate, 50 ng of genomic DNA from mice, 200 pM of sense and antisense oligonucleotides and water to final volume of 100 μL.
Incubate the reaction in thermocycler: 1 cycle at 95°C for 5 min, 40 cycles of 95°C for 1 min, 60°C for 30 s and 72°C for 15 s, 1 cycle 72°C for 5 min and hold at 8°C.
Analyze the obtained amplicon in a 2% agarose gel using a 100 bp ladder.
Cut the target amplicon gel band and purify with Qiaquick Gel extraction Kit following manufacturers’ instructions.
Determine the DNA concentration in spectrophotometer at 260/280.
Prepare one reaction for the insert using 2 μg DNA, 5 μL of 10X CutSmart buffer, 10 U Sac I, 10 U Xba I and water to final volume of 50 μL.
Incubate at 36°C for 3 h.
Inactivate enzymes by incubating at 65°C for 20 min.
Analyze the digested insert in a 2% agarose gel using an appropriate ladder.
Cut the target insert gel band and purify with Qiaquick Gel extraction Kit following manufacturers’ instructions.
Determine the DNA concentration in spectrophotometer at 260/280.
Prepare one reaction for the vector using 2 μg DNA, 5 μL of 10X CutSmart buffer, 10 U Sac I, 10 U Xba I and water to final volume of 50 μL.
Incubate at 36°C for 3 h.
Inactivate enzymes by incubating at 65°C for 20 min.
Analyze the digested vector in a 0.8% agarose gel using an appropriate ladder.
Cut the target vector gel band and purify with Qiaquick Gel extraction Kit following manufacturers’ instructions.
Determine the DNA concentration in spectrophotometer at 260/280.

Prepare the mix for ligation containing 50 ng of pmirGLO Dual-Luciferase miRNA Target Expression Vector and insert in a ratio of 1 vector molecule to 3 insert molecules, 1 μL of 10X Ligation Buffer, 1 U T4 DNA Ligase and water to final volume of 10 μL.
Prepare control reactions: non-insert, non-ligase, and non-digested-vector.
Incubate all reactions at 25°C for 3 h.
Transform the ligation products into high efficient E. coli competent cells by thermal shock.
Incubate on-ice for 20 min.
Heat-shock at 42°C in water-bath for 1.5 min.
Immediately return to ice and leave there for 2 min.
Add 800 μL of SOB medium.
Incubate at 36°C for 1 h.
Plate 100 μL on solid agar-SOB containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin.
Incubate the plate at 36°C overnight.
Transfer colonies to 4 mL of SOB medium containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin.
Incubate overnight at 36°C.
Perform a standard plasmid DNA miniprep extraction protocol.
Determine the DNA concentration in spectrophotometer at 260/280.
Verify the presence of the insert using restriction enzyme digestion of the purified-miniprep DNA.
Prepare the mix for insert or vector with 1 μg DNA, 1 μL of 10X CutSmart buffer, 1 U Xba I, 1 U Sca I and water to final volume of 10 μL.
Incubate at 36°C for 1 h.
Inactivate enzymes by incubating at 65°C for 20 min.
Analyze the presence of insert and vector in 1.5% agarose gel using a 100 bp and 1 kb ladder.
Remove the supernatant of BMDM.
Prepare an inhibitor mix containing 30 or 100 nM of miR-294-3p or miR-721 inhibitors plus 3 μL of the FuGENE HD transfection reagent in a total volume of 250 μL in serum-free RPMI 1640 medium.

Prepare a competition mix containing 0.1, 0.5 or 1 μM of the miR-294/ _Nos2_ or miR-721/ _Nos2_ miScript Target Protector or the negative control plus 3 μL of the FuGENE HD transfection reagent in a total volume of 250 μL in serum-free RPMI 1640 medium.

Prepare an interaction mix containing 5 μg of the pmiRGLO constructs and 100 nM of miRNAs mimics miR-294 or miR-721 plus 5 μL of the FuGENE HD transfection reagent in a total volume of 250 μL in serum-free RPMI 1640 medium.
Incubate each mix for 20 min at room temperature before transferring the 250 μL mix solutions to the culture wells.
Add 250 μL of RPMI 1640 medium supplemented as described above and incubate the cells at 34°C with 5% CO2.
Infect the cells with stationary-phase promastigotes _Leishmania (Viannia) amazonensis_ \(MOI 5:1) after 24h of initial incubation, and continue incubating for 24 and 48 hours.
Extract total RNA using miRNeasy® Mini kit.

Synthesize cDNA using miScript II RT Kit with a solution containing 250 ng of total RNA, 2 μL of 5x miScript HiSpec Buffer, 1 μL of 10x Nucleics Mix, and 1 μL of miScript Reverse Transcriptase Mix, adjusted to a final volume of 10 μL with RNAse-free water.
Incubate the cDNA synthesis mix for 60 min at 37°C followed by 5 min at 95°C in a thermocycler.

Prepare a solution for amplification of miR-294-3p, miR-721, and SNORD95A with 5 μL of ten-fold diluted cDNA, 2X SYBR Green PCR Master Mix, 10X miScript Universal Primer, 10X Specific Primer, and RNAse-free water to a final volume of 25 μL.
Incubate the amplification mix for 15 sec at 95°C followed by 40 cycles each of 15 sec at 94°C, 30 sec at 55°C, and 30 sec at 70°C in a thermocycler.
Produce cDNA using 2 μg of total RNA, 2 μL of 10 mM dNTPs, 2 μL of random primer, and RNAse-free water to a final volume of 32 μL.
Incubate the mixture at 70°C for 5 min followed by 4°C for 10 min.
Add 4 μL of 5x Buffer, 2 μL of Ribolock inhibitor, and 2 μL of reverse transcriptase to the RNA solution.
Incubate the cDNA synthesis reaction at 37°C for 5 min, then at 42°C for 60 min followed by 15 minutes at 75°C in a thermocycler.
Prepare a solution for mRNA quantification with 5 μL of 100-fold diluted cDNA, 2X SYBR Green PCR Master Mix, 0.4 μM of each corresponding primer pair, and RNAse-free water to a final volume of 25 μL.
Incubate the reaction for 1 cycle of 5 min at 94°C, followed by 40 cycles at 94°C for 30 sec and at 60°C for 30 sec in a Real-Time Thermocycler.
Fix infected cells with methanol/acetone (1:1; 15 min at -20°C).
Permeabilize fixed cells with 0.5% Tween 20 in PBS 1X for 30 min at 4°C.
Block permeabilized cells with Odyssey Blocking Buffer for 1 hour at room temperature, in rocking shaker.
Incubate cells with 1:200 dilutions of rabbit anti-NOS2 or mouse anti-β-actin antibodies in Odyssey Blocking Buffer overnight at 4°C.
Wash cells three times with PBS plus 0.05% Tween 20.

Incubate cells with 1:5000 dilutions of IRDye®800CW-conjugated goat anti-rabbit IgG or IgG IRDye®680 LT-conjugated donkey anti-mouse antibodies in Odyssey Blocking Buffer for 1 hour at 4°C, protect from light.
Measure the fluorescence of each well at 700 nm and 800 nm with Odyssey CLx system at standard settings to acquire data.
Calculate relative NOS2 fluorescence intensity by normalizing values by β-actin fluorescence using Image software (LICOR).
Lysate cells with 100 μL RIPA buffer at 4°C for 15 min.
Clarify the protein extract by centrifugation at 8000 x g for 10 min at 4°C.
Incubate 20 μL of each extract with 20 μL of Dual-Glo® Luciferase reagent for 5 min at room temperature.
Measure firefly luciferase luminescence at luminometer.
Add 100 μL of Dual-Glo® Stop-Glo® Substrate to the mixture and incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Measure the luminescence.
Normalize the values of firefly luciferase by renilla luciferase.
Compare the values of pmiRGLO-construct with or without miRNA mimics to pmiRGLO-empty vector.
